welcome_title: Teaching tools that fit the phone you already have.
welcome_body: Prepare lessons, take attendance and keep families informed, even when the network does not cooperate.
welcome_bullet_1: Plan and teach with a clear 5E lesson structure.
welcome_bullet_2: Take attendance and keep an accurate class record.
welcome_bullet_3: Record short, factual progress observations for teacher review.
welcome_bullet_4: Keep family contact in one place while guardians stay on ordinary SMS.
welcome_bullet_5: Use the optional teaching helper, with a reviewed offline fallback.

lesson_not_found_body: This lesson is not saved on this device.
teaching_tip_body: Ask one quiet pupil to explain the idea in their own words. Listen for the part that is still fuzzy, then re-teach only that part.
honest_scope_body: This is a teacher-authored scaffold, not generated grading and not a claim of complete NERDC coverage. Review before classroom use.
curriculum_note: Curriculum source and version metadata are not attached to this sample plan. Do not present it as a verified NERDC pack.
progress_subtitle: A short instructional observation, reviewed before sharing.
factual_hint: No diagnosis, labels or comparisons with other pupils.
factual_placeholder: What did this pupil do or say?
home_placeholder: One short activity a family can try.
no_observations: No observations recorded for this pupil.
progress_saved: Progress draft saved on this device.

not_assessed_note: Not assessed means no observation was recorded. It is not a negative judgment.

queued_reply_note: A queued reply is not a delivery confirmation. The simulated provider records acceptance only.

sync_subtitle: What is saved on this device, what is queued, and what has genuinely been acknowledged.
sync_center_note: This workspace stores changes locally. Server sync is unavailable under the current zero-cost configuration; queued items are never shown as synced without a real acknowledgement.
nothing_queued_body: Local edits appear here. A synced state appears only after a real acknowledgement.
server_sync_body: Cloud Functions are emulator-only in this zero-cost build. This hosted workspace cannot send queued commands to a deployed server; it shows them as pending rather than pretending they synced.
offline_point_1: All workspace state is written to the local database and a backup.
offline_point_2: Attendance and message drafts are saved while typing.
offline_point_3: Queued commands survive refresh and retry with an honest state.
offline_point_4: Conflict and rejected states are never silently overwritten.
sync_unavailable: Server sync is unavailable in this zero-cost configuration. Queued work remains saved on this device.
sync_complete: Emulator sync completed. Review any conflict or rejected items.
sync_failed: Sync attempt failed. Queued work remains on this device.
storage_no_remote: Signed in. No remote workspace was found; the sample local workspace is shown.
storage_remote_loaded: Workspace loaded from Firestore. Writes remain local until a server sync path is available.
storage_bootstrap_failed: The remote workspace could not be loaded. Local work is unaffected.
class_saved_local: Class saved on this device and queued.

settings_subtitle: Account, language, accessibility, privacy and the limits of this workspace.

about_body: Tiny is an offline-first teacher-support and family-engagement product for primary schools. Teachers use the app; parents use ordinary SMS; pupils have no accounts.
evaluation_disclosure: This hosted workspace contains sample records and a synthetic account. It is not connected to real children, guardians or SMS.
settings_local_note: Sample data is stored in this browser. Local data is not encrypted; do not enter real personal information.
settings_server_note: Remote writes are unavailable under the current zero-cost configuration.
language_draft_disclosure: Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo are complete draft translations awaiting native review. English remains the fallback.
wifi_only_summary: Automatic background sync waits for unmetered Wi-Fi. Manual sync can request a one-time exception.
class_created_local: Class saved on this device and queued.
verification_code_issued: Verification code issued. Read it to the guardian in person.
verification_code_mismatch: The verification code does not match.
create_workspace_hint: A local workspace is created with a generated school code.
ai_subtitle: Optional teaching support that never blocks the lesson.
ai_privacy_note: No pupil names, phone numbers or records are sent to a model. AI cannot grade, diagnose or send family content.
ai_device_available: Gemini Nano is available on this device.
ai_device_unavailable: On-device Gemini Nano is unavailable here. Cloud inference is used when available; the reviewed offline library remains available.
ai_device_downloadable: Gemini Nano can be downloaded on this device.
ai_cloud_fallback_note: Cloud inference is used when the on-device model is unavailable. The source label always comes from the SDK response.
ai_ask_body: Uses a de-identified Primary 4 science prompt. Review every suggestion before using or sharing it.
ai_offline_body: These strategies are bundled in the app and work without a network or model.
ai_error: The teaching helper could not respond. The offline library is still available.
ai_review_note: Teacher review is required before using any suggestion.
ai_acceptance_note: On-device Gemini Nano requires supported physical hardware and is not claimed here. The source label comes from the SDK response, never from configuration alone.
ai_mode_lesson_plan_prompt: Draft a short Primary 4 basic science lesson outline about sources and uses of water using the 5E structure. Use at most 140 English words.
ai_mode_explain_prompt: Explain the water cycle in simple English for a Primary 4 teacher, with one local example. Use at most 100 words.
ai_mode_adapt_prompt: Suggest three ways to adapt a Primary 4 water lesson for pupils with mixed reading levels, using low-cost classroom materials. Use at most 120 English words.
ai_mode_assess_prompt: Suggest a five-question quick check for understanding after a Primary 4 lesson on sources and uses of water. Include answers. Use at most 140 English words.
ai_mode_support_prompt: Suggest two practical ways a teacher can support a pupil who is still unsure about sources of water, without labelling or diagnosing the child. Use at most 100 English words.
ai_mode_parent_note_prompt: Draft a short, factual, friendly family message about the week's water lesson and one home activity. Do not mention any pupil name, phone number, grade or diagnosis. Use at most 60 English words.
ai_nano_note: Chrome built-in AI requires a supported browser, the model, sufficient hardware and model download. This workspace does not claim on-device execution unless the SDK reports it.
ai_core_body: If both on-device and cloud are unavailable, reviewed offline strategies appear. Attendance, lessons and local records continue to work.
ai_curated_used: The reviewed offline strategy is shown because a model was not available.
ai_browser_detected: Built-in browser AI detected; checked at generation
ai_browser_server: Browser capability is not available here
ai_strategy_1_body: Give pupils 30 seconds to think, 60 seconds to explain to a partner, then choose two pairs to share with the class.
ai_strategy_2_body: Ask pupils to write one sentence about what they are still unsure of. Read three aloud without names and correct the class together.
ai_strategy_3_body: Start with a local object, picture or story. Ask pupils to describe what they notice before introducing the formal term.
help_subtitle: Practical guidance for the classroom, written in plain language.
help_search_placeholder: Search a topic, for example attendance
help_no_results: No help topic matches that search.
help_tour_teacher_body: A short walkthrough of the dashboard, classes, attendance, lessons, progress, family messages, the teaching helper, offline work and sync.
help_tour_guardian_body: How families use ordinary SMS: absence alerts, weekly updates, replies and consent.
help_limitations_body: This workspace does not send live SMS, deploy Cloud Functions, or claim cross-device sync. AI is optional; on-device Gemini Nano needs supported hardware. Sample records are used throughout.
help_contact_body: Ask your school lead or the Tiny pilot contact for help with accounts, devices or privacy questions.
help_getting_started_body: Choose your language, open your workspace and use Home for the next useful action. Everything you create is saved on this device first.
help_classes_body: Open Classes, choose Add class, pick the grade, add a section label such as Blue, and save. You can teach more than one class and switch at any time.
help_pupils_body: Open a class, choose Add pupil and enter a display name. A local code is optional. Use sample records in this evaluation workspace, never real child data.
help_guardians_body: Add a guardian endpoint, link it to a pupil and record consent. One guardian may be linked to several pupils. Verify in person before any family message.
help_attendance_body: Open a class and choose Mark attendance. Mark every active pupil, save a draft if needed, then submit. Only absences can trigger an immediate message after server acceptance.
help_lessons_body: Open Lessons, create a draft and complete the objective, materials and five 5E stages. The plan is stored offline and remains available without a network.
help_progress_body: Open a pupil from the roster, write a short factual observation and save a draft. Approve it before it can enter a family digest. Never use AI grading or diagnosis.
help_messages_body: Open Messages to read family replies and queue a short response. A queued message is not a delivery confirmation. Guardian SMS is simulated here.
help_ai_body: Choose what you need, generate an idea and review it. No pupil names or records are sent. If a model is unavailable, a reviewed offline strategy appears.
help_offline_body: Classes, attendance, lessons, progress and drafts stay usable without a signal. The offline banner tells you when the device is disconnected.
help_sync_body: The outbox shows what is saved and queued. Synced appears only after a real server acknowledgement. Server sync is unavailable in this zero-cost build.
help_troubleshooting_body: If a screen looks empty, return to Home and reopen it. If sign-in fails, check the number or evaluation details. If AI is unavailable, use the offline library. Reset local sample data from Settings when needed.
help_privacy_body: Use synthetic records only in this workspace. Do not enter real pupil or guardian information. Local browser data is not encrypted; the Android app uses an encrypted database.
help_guardian_guide_body: Guardians do not install Tiny and do not need an account. They receive and send ordinary SMS.
help_guardian_step_1: An absence alert arrives after the school register is accepted. Present and late do not trigger an immediate alert.
help_guardian_step_2: A weekly digest contains only approved, factual learning updates and school notices.
help_guardian_step_3: A guardian can reply to the school SMS. The teacher sees the reply in the family inbox.
help_guardian_step_4: STOP and START control consent. Unverified or ambiguous senders never receive child details.
tour_teacher_intro: A short walkthrough of the teacher workspace. You can leave at any time and replay it from Help.
tour_guardian_intro: Families use ordinary SMS. This short guide explains what they receive and how consent works.
tour_step_1_body: Home shows today's classes, attendance status, queued work and unread family messages. Start with the next useful action.
tour_step_2_body: Classes keeps every class and roster in one place. Open a class to see pupils, registers and lessons.
tour_step_3_body: Inside a class, choose Add pupil and enter a display name. A short local code is optional. This evaluation uses sample records only.
tour_step_4_body: Mark every active pupil present, absent or late. Save a draft or submit the register. Only absences can trigger an immediate family alert after server acceptance.
tour_step_5_body: Create a teacher-authored 5E plan with objective, materials, Engage, Explore, Explain, Elaborate and Evaluate. Plans stay available offline.
tour_step_6_body: Open a pupil and record a short factual observation. Approve it before it can enter a family digest. AI never grades or diagnoses a child.
tour_step_7_body: The family inbox collects guardian SMS replies. Queue a short factual response. A queued reply is not a delivery confirmation.
tour_step_8_body: The optional helper suggests lesson ideas, explanations, adaptations, checks and family-message drafts. Review everything; offline strategies always remain available.
tour_step_9_body: Attendance, lessons, progress, classes and drafts work without a network. The offline banner appears when the connection drops.
tour_step_10_body: The sync centre shows what is stored and queued. A synced state appears only after a real acknowledgement. No cloud write is claimed in this zero-cost build.
tour_guardian_step_1_body: A guardian receives an SMS when a pupil is absent and the school register has been accepted. Present and late do not trigger an immediate alert.
tour_guardian_step_2_body: On Friday afternoon, an approved digest can include factual learning updates and school notices. Nothing unapproved is shared.
tour_guardian_step_3_body: A guardian can reply to the school SMS. The teacher reads it in the family inbox and can queue a response.
tour_guardian_step_4_body: STOP and START control consent. Child details are never sent to unverified or ambiguous senders. This evaluation simulates SMS only.
tour_completed: Tour completed. You can replay it from Help.
tour_keyboard_hint: Use the arrow keys to move between steps. Press Escape to close.
